national_representativeness.pl: Oficjalne zbiory administracyjne opisują określone populacje i zakresy. Ankieta i czaty nie są reprezentatywne dla wszystkich wnioskodawców.
national_representativeness.be: Афіцыйныя адміністрацыйныя звесткі апісваюць вызначаныя сукупнасці. Апытанне і чаты не рэпрэзентуюць усіх заяўнікаў.
national_representativeness.en: Official administrative collections describe defined populations and scopes. Survey and chat samples do not represent all applicants.

sources.ingestion: JSON-stat dimension codes, labels, values and status flags; preserve source update timestamp and immutable retrieval hash.
sources.boundary: Non-EU first-permit flow, not all migrants, waiting time, pending cases or voivode-only temporary decisions. EU27 includes Poland.

sources.ingestion: Annual31December stock with citizenship/reason/validity definitions and flags.
sources.boundary: Valid-authorisation stock is not a stock of unfinished applications. Do not add to first permits or use as the denominator of a wait estimate.

sources.ingestion: Snapshot official dictionaries and API response schemas before values. Add revisions, operational cut-off where known and permit/event scope.
sources.boundary: Applications, decisions, valid documents, temporary protection and persons are separate measures. Public operational API should not be treated as a guaranteed stable/versioned API.

sources.ingestion: Discover only official annual/half-year workbooks; verify symbol labels and layout. Reconcile16 jurisdictions/national totals and movement/outcome partitions.
sources.boundary: 6272 is broad immigration scope; WSA first instance is not NSA cassation. Half-year and annual periods differ. Merit, rejection, other and closure denominators differ.

sources.ingestion: Monthly/quarterly XLSX by foreign citizenship and insurance-title group; verify whether geography is payer, branch, workplace or residence.
sources.boundary: Insured persons are not all foreign residents or residence applicants; insurance titles can overlap. No linked administrative-wait outcome is established.

sources.ingestion: Discover variable IDs and geographic codes through metadata; cache monthly publications and revision flags.
sources.boundary: Experimental persons-performing-work scope differs from employment/insurance. Statistical regions can split Mazowieckie; explicitly map NUTS/TERYT to project geography before aggregation.

sources.ingestion: Preserve collection definitions, legal basis, coverage and revision policy alongside counts.
sources.boundary: Cross-country permit volumes are not a ranking of waiting times or administrative efficiency; national visa/status reporting differs.

sources.ingestion: Request matching office/permit/cohort definitions, submission/registration/completeness dates, outcomes, headcount versus FTE, open-stock age buckets and cut-offs. Ask for aggregate definitions and machine-readable tables, no personal identifiers.
sources.boundary: Requesting data is not publishing evidence. Differences require clarification, not forced reconciliation; cost and disclosure limits need confirmation before sending.

sources.ingestion: Authorized API with credit/spending cap, or manually submitted public URLs; verify each factual lead against the original institution.
sources.boundary: No scraping/paywall bypass or promised completeness. Search results, engagement and language-selected posts are not representative wait/sentiment measures. Respect deletion and redistribution rules.

backend.frontend: Static GitHub Pages; translationsPL/BE/EN; no secrets in browser
backend.submission: Cloudflare Worker: strict payload schema, prepared D1 statements, Turnstile Siteverify including hostname/action/single-use, idempotency key, bounded size and request budget
backend.storage: D1 structured questionnaire and change events; separate restricted optional contact store; optional private R2 content-addressed source snapshots
backend.public_reads: Precomputed reviewed aggregate JSON served statically; no public raw-response endpoint
backend.updates: ConditionalGET then SHA comparison; normalize changed sources only; candidate diff and tests; independent review; versioned immutable release; manual promotion
backend.llm_budget: No LLM on routine fetch/parse/submission. Human/targeted OCR for changed ambiguous scans only.
backend.cost: Low-volume Free-plan target, benchmark first. Workers Paid minimum$5/month if needed; other products, domains, email and overages separate. Budget alerts and kill switch required.

retention_proposal.provider_logs_and_backups: must be configured and documented before launch

survey_limits: Self-selection, language/channel coverage and nonresponse remain; no national representativeness.
Completed and right-censored ongoing cases are separate. Month-only dates are intervals, not exact invented dates.
Cross-sectional long waits can be length-biased; survival methods do not remove selection/informative-censoring bias.
Token/idempotency protects edits and replay, not one-person uniqueness. Similar office/month/type is only a soft flag.
Optional email has separate consent/storage and is never a public analytical field.
Proposed10-person cells and complementary suppression protect privacy, not statistical representativeness.
